meta.title: Stealth reader
meta.description: A floating reading panel in the bottom-right corner of the DeepSeek Harness window. Open it with Ctrl+Alt+N, or click the small arrow above the composer. It reads local .txt, .epub, .docx, .md and .html files as well as public web novels, splits them into chapters, and remembers your position per book. The panel shows a progress bar, a chapter jump box, a search that highlights matches and steps through them, and reading settings for text size, line spacing, font and width. Add a document from the library drawer: pick a folder to import every supported file in it at once, or scan the remembered folders for files to add one by one. Chapter text stays inside the panel and never enters a session transcript, and the agent tool that manages the library reports counts and positions only, never a title or a path. GBK and UTF-8 documents are both read. Fetched web chapters are cached on disk, so re-reading makes no network request. Turning the plugin off removes the panel and the tool; the cached chapters stay on disk. A website library adds your usual novel sites once: browse and sign in inside the isolated desktop browser, then identify the current book, check its cleaned sample text, and add it to the library with one confirmation. No password or Cookie is copied, and sign-in stays inside that temporary browser session.
